 1 | package de.tum.cit.aet.sorting;
 2 | 
 3 | import java.util.*;
 4 | 
 5 | public class MergeSort implements SortStrategy {
 6 | 
 7 |     /**
 8 |      * Wrapper method for the real MergeSort algorithm.
 9 |      *
10 |      * @param input the List of Dates to be sorted
11 |      */
12 |     public void performSort(List<Date> input) {
13 |         mergesort(input, 0, input.size() - 1);
14 |     }
15 | 
16 |     /**
17 |      * Recursive merge sort method
18 |      * @oracleIgnore
19 |      */
20 |     private void mergesort(List<Date> input, int low, int high) {
21 |         if (high - low < 1) {
22 |             return;
23 |         }
24 |         int mid = (low + high) / 2;
25 |         mergesort(input, low, mid);
26 |         mergesort(input, mid + 1, high);
27 |         merge(input, low, mid, high);
28 |     }
29 | 
30 |     /**
31 |      * Merge method
32 |      * @oracleIgnore
33 |      */
34 |     private void merge(List<Date> input, int low, int middle, int high) {
35 | 
36 |         Date[] temp = new Date[high - low + 1];
37 |         int leftIndex = low;
38 |         int rightIndex = middle + 1;
39 |         int wholeIndex = 0;
40 |         while (leftIndex <= middle && rightIndex <= high) {
41 |             if (input.get(leftIndex).compareTo(input.get(rightIndex)) <= 0) {
42 |                 temp[wholeIndex] = input.get(leftIndex++);
43 |             }
44 |             else {
45 |                 temp[wholeIndex] = input.get(rightIndex++);
46 |             }
47 |             wholeIndex++;
48 |         }
49 |         if (leftIndex <= middle && rightIndex > high) {
50 |             while (leftIndex <= middle) {
51 |                 temp[wholeIndex++] = input.get(leftIndex++);
52 |             }
53 |         }
54 |         else {
55 |             while (rightIndex <= high) {
56 |                 temp[wholeIndex++] = input.get(rightIndex++);
57 |             }
58 |         }
59 |         for (wholeIndex = 0; wholeIndex < temp.length; wholeIndex++) {
60 |             input.set(wholeIndex + low, temp[wholeIndex]);
61 |         }
62 |     }
63 | }
